reviews.text: Called for a part i couldn't find anywhere else. They had a used one and offered it to me for free. Worked perfectly.  10 out of 10. They have my business moving forward.
reviews.author: Jonathan Parks

reviews.text: Claffey did a wonderful job building our dream pool and oasis. They blew us away with their design and the finished product turned out better than we could have dreamed of. I highly recommend Claffey.
reviews.author: B

reviews.text: “Alex Bowers” did a terrible job on my pool. Would give zero stars if I could. The guy needs to be fired
reviews.author: John Forte

reviews.text: Working with Claffey Pools was fantastic, very professional.  Starting with Reid in Design and Sales to our foreman Steve, it was great.  They delivered on all they said they would.  Our final product was everything we hoped it would be and better.  It has really completed our yard and home.  Thanks Claffey!
reviews.author: Dr. Dan Lopez

reviews.text: I brought the polaris cleaner to the retailer store and they very quickly fixed it for a reasonable price. Helpful staff who were willing to share their expertise adjusting the floats etc to remedy a problem.
reviews.author: Kristin Wolf

reviews.text: I was told by a friend that Claffey was worth every penny when it came to buying a new pool and that's some of the best advice I've ever received. Couldn't be happier with the great customer service and the final product. Already looking forward to this upcoming summer to be outside every day relaxing by the pool or cooking food from our new outdoor kitchen.
reviews.author: Randy Smith

reviews.text: Our pool badly needed a major facelift and we chose Claffey among several competing companies and we have never been happier with a decision. From start to completion they kept us involved. They were professional, friendly, and knowledgable, to list only a few of the accolades. Their service department is without equal. John Cita sets the bar to exceed the competition. The retail out let led by Mark Emory handles all of our ongoing retail needs. Mark's management style is reflected in a well run ship that's like going home every visit. I have another retail outlet down the street as well as  the big outlet's nearby, but we choose to fill all our needs where the service is beyond comparison and they go the extra mile and so do we. Thanks Claffey-your new offices truly are a reflection of what you can create, like you did for us.
reviews.author: Myles Walsh

reviews.text: We had a really, really great experience. Everyone knew what they were doing and they were good at it. Our old pool was completely removed and we started over. I was not  looking forward to what we went through when the first pool was built.....awful. I was so pleasantly surprised by Claffey. We had no issues, none.

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic but present a mixed picture. Google reviews (mostly older, very positive) conflict with the lower Yelp rating, suggesting potential service variability or that negative experiences are concentrated on Yelp. The single negative Google review names a specific employee, adding credibility. The company appears to handle retail repairs well. The small total review volume across platforms makes definitive conclusions difficult.
fake_signals: Small Google review sample (8) limits statistical reliability
Google reviews span 9 years, suggesting low recent volume

positive_evidence: Fixed Polaris cleaner for reasonable price
Offered a used part for free

authentic_signals: Specific employee names (Reid, Steve, John Cita, Mark Emory, Alex Bowers)
Detailed project descriptions (pool build, renovation, retail repair)
Mix of retail service and construction project reviews
complaint_patterns: Poor workmanship by specific employee (Alex Bowers)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.5) and Yelp (3.4). Google sample is small (8 reviews) and heavily weighted with older, positive reviews. Yelp has more reviews (32) and likely includes more recent, varied experiences, suggesting Google's rating may not reflect current or complete sentiment.
